sections.fixed_text:
For the purposes of this project, the UNHCR is to commit to the following activities: 
 - Placement of GIFR and GIFR Donors’ logos on equipment, banners and implementation sites of the project. 
 - Acknowledge GIFR and GIFR Donors’ contribution in UNHCR’s annual report on its website, as well as in the project’s final report.
 - Share audiovisual materials reflecting the humanitarian support enabled by GIFR and GIFR Donors’ contributions. 
 - Invite the donors (GIFR and GIFR Donors) to attend landmark steps in the implementation of the project activities (such as the; letter of engagements  with government partners, the handover of equipment, opening of boreholes…etc.). 
 - Provide GIFR and GIFR Donors with human success stories and photos with the necessary authorization for publication to enable IsDB to communicate on the project. 
 
   Any communication will be shared in advance with each party and require written approval before any direct or indirect publication.

Provide a structured project implementation timeline covering the full duration of the project (maximum 12 months). The table should present the sequencing of key outcomes, outputs, and activities across months, clearly indicating when each activity will start and end. Ensure that: 
 - The timeline aligns with the logical framework and project activities described in earlier sections. 
- Each activity is realistically scheduled, reflecting implementation feasibility and dependencies. 
- Major milestones (e.g., project start, mid-term review, completion) are clearly identifiable.
 - Overlaps and sequencing between activities are coherent and justified. 
 - The plan demonstrates efficient use of time and supports timely delivery of results. 

 Use the table format to map activities against months (Month 1–Month 12), marking the periods of implementation (e.g., with “X”).
